719-3000-3510-4288.easyPrerequisites:
You can cause a creature or land to enter under your control.
Saproling has been chosen with Xenograft.
719-3000-3510-4288.description:
Cause a creature or land to enter under your control.
Each creature or land that entered is a Saproling through Xenograft and a Forest in addition to its other types due to and Life and Limb, causing Sarinth Greatwurm to trigger that many times.
Resolve a Sarinth Greatwurm trigger, creating the stated artifact tokens plus at least one creature token through Chatterfang.
Repeat steps 2-3. Unless you have a way to remove one of the pieces, this will cause an infinite mandatory loop and draw the game.

4186-4279-7286.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least two additional creatures.
Scurry Oak has no +1/+1 counters on it.
Your life total is at least 2.
4186-4279-7286.description:
Cast Yawgmoth by paying {2}{B}{B}.
When Yawgmoth enters the battlefield, Scurry Oak's evolve ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, South Wind Avatar triggers, causing you to gain life. Its second ability then triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on Scurry Oak and causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Scurry Oak trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it, triggering Scurry Oak's second ability.
Holding priority, activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, South Wind Avatar triggers, causing you to gain life. Its second ability then triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on Scurry Oak and causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Scurry Oak trigger, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
When the Squirrel enters the battlefield, Scurry Oak's evolve ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it, triggering Scurry Oak's second ability.
Repeat from step 7.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

5256-6972-7841.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Darksteel Angel
When Darksteel Angel dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its static effect.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing a player to mill a number of cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power
Repeat.

uses.n: Fable of the Mirror-Breaker // Reflection of Kiki-Jiki

996-2105-3337.easyPrerequisites: Reflection of Kiki-Jiki does not have summoning sickness.
996-2105-3337.description:
Activate Reflection of KIki-Jiki by paying {1} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Combat Celebrant with haste.
Declare Ragavan and Combat Celebrant token as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
When you attack, the token Combat Celebrant triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
When you deal combat damage, Ragavan triggers, creating at least one Treasure token.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana.
Repeat.

824-2728-3967-6012.easyPrerequisites:
Genestealer Patriarch does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent controls a creature.
Leech Bonder is tapped and does not have summoning sickness.
824-2728-3967-6012.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two additional creatures.
824-2728-3967-6012.description:
Declare Genestealer Patriarch as an attacker.
Genestealer Patriarch's first ability triggers, putting an infection counter on a creature an opponent controls.
Activate Leech Bonder's ability by paying its cost, moving the infection counter from the opponent's creature onto a creature you control.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the creature with an infection counter on it.
When the creature dies, Reluctant Role Model and Genestealer Patriarch's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Reluctant Role Model trigger, putting an infection counter onto another creature you control.
Resolve the Genestealer Patriarch trigger, causing you to create a token copy of the sacrificed creature that is a Tyranid in addition to its other types.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat from step 4.

553-2093-6108.description:
During the opponent's end step immediately before your turn, cast Approach of the Second Sun by paying {6}{W} using High Fae Trickster.
In response, cast Lapse of Certainty by paying its mana cost, putting Approach of the Sun on top of your library.
In your draw step, draw Approach of the Second Sun.
Cast Approach of the Second Sun by paying {6}{W}, winning the game.

215-1129-1251.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four Allies.
215-1129-1251.description:
Activate Harabaz Druid by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Harabaz Druid from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Harabaz Druid by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

uses.n: Heliod, the Radiant Dawn // Heliod, the Warped Eclipse

3532-4668-5078-7314.notablePrerequisites: Opponents have drawn at least one card this turn.
3532-4668-5078-7314.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Baxter triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

2113-5051-5078-6918.description:
Activate Traxos by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Traxos triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.

546-4613-5900-7234.easyPrerequisites: There are a total of at least five cards in all hands.
546-4613-5900-7234.description:
Activate Lilysplash Mentor by paying {1}{G}{U}, blinking Realm Seekers. Realm Seekers enters with at least five +1/+1 counters due to its replacement effect.
Activate Realm Seekers using Ramos's ability by removing five +1/+1 counters from it, adding {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G}.
Repeat.

273-1796-7070.description:
Activate Shuko's equip ability by paying {0}, targeting another nontoken creature you control.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending the targeted creature.
The Shuko ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast the creature from exile by paying {0} due to Centaur Omenreader.
Repeat.

2034-2919-3490-4210.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2034-2919-3490-4210.description:
Gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Pious Evangel triggers if it's on the battlefield.
Regardless, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}
When the Servo dies, Wayward Disciple triggers if it's on the battlefield.
Resolve either the Pious Evangel or Wayward Disciple trigger, causing you to gain life and target opponent to lose 1 life if Wayward Disciple triggered.
Repeat from step 2.

2275-3532-5078-6259.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Shabraz triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and causing you to gain 1 life.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

997-1778-2173-5220.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Memnite
When Memnite dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Memnite from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Cast Memnite from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

3542-3647-5913.notablePrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {2}{U}.
3542-3647-5913.description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}.
Cast Displace by paying {2}{U}, blinking Pinnacle Monk and Palinchron
When Pinnacle Monk and Palinchron enter the battlefield, their abilities trigger.
Resolve the Pinnacle Monk trigger, returning Displace from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Palinchron trigger, untapping up to seven lands.
Repeat.
3542-3647-5913.notes: If you control seven lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana, and you may blink any other permanent besides Palinchron.

955-2034-5003-6773.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another nontoken creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers. Choose not to pay.
Activate Xu-Ifit by tapping it, returning a creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Xu-Ifit, adding {C}{C}.
When Xu-Ifit dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return it from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Repeat.

339-677-2438-5295.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

2178-5173-5256-6095.easyPrerequisites:
Zul Ashur, Lich Lord does not have summoning sickness.
Thornbite Staff attached to Zul Ashur.
2178-5173-5256-6095.description:
Activate Zul Ashur by tapping it, targeting Shambling Ghast.
Cast Shambling Ghast from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Shambling Ghast.
When Shambing Ghast dies, it and Zul Ashur trigger.
Resolve the Shambling Ghast trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Zul Ashur trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

659-2034-5090.easyPrerequisites:
Krenko, Mob Boss does not have summoning sickness.
Singing Bell Strike attached to Krenko.
659-2034-5090.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three Goblins.
659-2034-5090.description:
Activate Krenko by tapping it, creating at least three 1/1 Goblin creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar three times by sacrificing three Goblin tokens, adding six {C}.
Activate Singing Bell Strike by paying {6}, untapping Krenko.
Repeat.

4365-4508-5880-5929.description:
Activate Magmaw by paying {1} and sacrificing another nonland permanent, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Valentin, Dean of the Vein // Lisette, Dean of the Root

883-2034-3097-3490.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Ashes of the Abhorrent triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Lisette triggers, causing you to pay {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Animation Module triggers for each counter placed this way.
Resolve the first trigger, choosing to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Resolve all other triggers, choosing not to pay.
Repeat.

549-3259-4359-5953.easyPrerequisites: Breath of Fury attached to any other creature you control.
549-3259-4359-5953.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
549-3259-4359-5953.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury and Aya of Alexandria trigger.
Resolve the Aya of Alexandria trigger, creating a 1/1 Assassin creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Assassin token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

2034-3887-5195-5853.notablePrerequisites: You do not control a Snail.
2034-3887-5195-5853.description:
Cast Lab Rats with buyback by paying {4}{B}.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve Lab Rats, creating a 1/1 Rat creature token and returning it to your hand.
When the Rat enters the battlefield, Wick triggers, creating a 1/1 Snail creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the Rat and Snail, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

1636-2486-3143.notablePrerequisites:
You control your commander.
There is at least one counter on a permanent you control.
You control at least one creature token.
1636-2486-3143.description:
Activate Xavier Sal's first ability by tapping it and removing a counter from a permanent you control, creating a copy of any creature token you control that enters the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

5371-5372.description:
Cast Soultether Golem by paying {2}.
Soultether Golem enters the battlefield with a time counter on it due to its vanishing ability.
Kate Stewart's first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters the battlefield, Soultether Golem's second ability triggers, putting a time counter on it.
Repeat from step 3.
NOTE: This combo creates a mandatory infinite loop that ends the game in a draw if it isn't interacted with.

3994-4659-5003.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Precursor Golem, adding {C}{C}.
When Precursor Golem dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Precursor Golem from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Precursor Golem enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, creating two 3/3 Golem creature tokens.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing a Golem, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

2668-2689-4050.notablePrerequisites: An opponent has a greater life total than you.
2668-2689-4050.description:
Cast Pulse of the Forge by paying {1}{R}{R}, targeting an opponent that has more life than you.
Resolve Pulse of the Forge, creating four 3/1 Elemental Shaman creature tokens with haste due to Hostility, and returning Pulse of the Forge to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar three times by sacrificing three Elemental Shamans, adding {1}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

1124-1651-2034-3836-5002.notablePrerequisites: Urza, Lord Protector and The Mightstone and Weakstone melded into Urza, Planeswalker.
1124-1651-2034-3836-5002.description:
Activate Urza, Planeswalker's third loyalty ability by putting no loyalty counters on it, creating two 1/1 Soldier artifact creature tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the two Soldiers, untapping The Chain Veil.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the two Soldiers, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate The Chain Veil by paying {4} and tapping it, allowing you an additional activation of your planeswalkers' loyalty abilities this turn.
Repeat.

265-2558-2829.description:
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Sly Requisitioner triggers, creating a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Sword of the Meek triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Servo token.
Resolve the Arcbound Ravager ability from step 1, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1283-2577-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Gravecrawler, adding {R}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {1}.
Repeat.

367-4527.notablePrerequisites: Sorin Markov has at least three loyalty counters.
367-4527.description:
Activate Sorin's -3 ability, targeting an opponent and putting them to 10 life.
Cast Hidetsugu's Second Rite targeting them, dealing 10 damage to them.

933-2493-4872.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying {3}{U}{U}, taking an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Conjurer's Closet triggers, blinking Archaeomancer.
Archaeomancer enters the battlefield, returning Time Warp from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
